note: Guidance vocabularies, not external authoritative catalogs. Packs extend interpretation; they do not alter the core evidence contract.

questions: What decision will this map support?
Which source governs when documents disagree?
Is this a requirement, a claimed practice, or directly observed implementation?
Who is accountable versus who performs the work?
What evidence supports scope, frequency, exceptions, and the last completed execution?
cautions: A policy is not proof of implementation.
A missing evidence record is not proof of control failure.
Do not assign SOC 2 or other external control IDs without an authorized, versioned reference.
Do not infer regulatory applicability or certify compliance.

questions: Is this architecture current, proposed, or retired?
Who performs the step and who is accountable?
